//: Type-checking for GkPlus entry modules. VS Code picks this up on its own;
on the command line it is `npx -y -p typescript tsc -p jsconfig.json` - the
`-p typescript` part being what fetches a compiler this repo does not depend on.
Both types/ globs are listed on purpose: `../types` is where they live in
the repo, and `types` is where they end up when you copy this folder into
<Gunlok>\gkplus\ - a glob that matches nothing is not an error.
`lib` has no DOM entry because the host has no DOM: the only globals are
the ES built-ins and the console types/gk.d.ts declares.
